locations: Met object 74448 / 2008.55, unidentified Korean artist, Joseon ca. 1551. Met calls this a gyehoedo, poetic inscription by Jeong Sa-ryong, finely described gatherings with cushions, books, writing utensils, attendants, food and drink at lower right amid ideal landscape. Met page describes sixty-year-old officials, but the Met 2009 catalogue (print p99, PDF p112 zero-index p111) translated inscription says born in same year, roughly contemporaneous civil/military exams and now approaching seventy; exact age should be qualified.
